completion:
Verify all records used to support a claim.
3. Confirm that all referenced records are labelled, sealed and subject to discovery in litigation.
4. Identify the cause of failure to comply with fire-safety regulations and whose actions make NCORs fail.
5. Determine if a building is at risk based on the objective criteria, and document the fire-safety risk implications in inspection records and report analysis.
6. Give headway guidance by providing strict written reminders and other help to landlords who do not comply with fire-safety regulations.
